decisions.decision: Postgres-maximalist: recursive CTEs for graph traversal, no Apache AGE or external graph DB
decisions.rationale: Deterministic, fast, already have pgvector + Prisma raw SQL patterns

decisions.decision: Entity extraction piggybacked on existing embedding queues, not a separate queue
decisions.rationale: Single pipeline, doubles API calls but uses cheap mistral-small model

decisions.decision: save_memory tool gets explicit contactId/emailId optional params for auto-anchoring

decisions.decision: 4K token budget split 60/20/20 (graph/memory/few-shot), structured extraction only
decisions.rationale: No LLM summarization — graph structure provides the summary via relationship paths
